chunks: And Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf narrated from Uthman ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Mihran ibn Muhammad, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): He gave a directive that mourning be held for him for seven seasons, so he endowed for each season a sum of money to be spent.

key_terms.أَوْقَفَ: he endowed / he established a waqf
key_terms.يُنَاحَ: to be mourned / to hold mourning rituals

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on endowing money for seasonal mourning rituals according to the Imams?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the precedent for institutionalizing mourning rituals through perpetual endowments (waqf), ensuring financial sustainability for commemorative events over seven annual cycles. It highlights the practical application of waqf in Shia jurisprudence to support religious and social obligations, reflecting the Imamate's emphasis on maintaining the memory of key figures through structured communal resources.
